tools.description: The front door for any goal or problem the owner states, in their own words. tools.name: advance_outcome

During the run: data, start, complete (with outputs and checks), approve (owner only), skip, block, r

tools.description: Record what the owner chose, the options considered (best-ranked first), what they passed over and why. Passing over the top option needs a reason. Returns a line for decisions.jsonl and, if a durable rule was stated, a learning candidate with where to save it.

Concise (default): summary, inputs, outputs, how to use, file list with hashes, and step_map (what usually goes before and after it and the input each passes on). response_format detailed adds the full SKILL.md instructions and resource links; use it before running the skill. Returns a diagram you can show the user (Mermaid; detailed adds a text outline) and open_in_builder, a link that opens it in the site's bui

Binary files return a download descriptor for the host to retrieve and verify. Paths are archive-relative, never arbitrary URLs or filesyst

tools.description: Check a workflow, or a change to one. Call it whenever the user wants to see, check or change a workflow (swap, add, remove or reorder steps), and before showing any plan. tools.name: get_item
tools.description: Get one item of any kind by the id from search_library: an agent, prompt, mind, AI tool or mini tool (skills and workflows work too). Concise (default): what it does, inputs and outputs, how to use it, files or links, and for AI tools the price, limits and when we last checked. response_format detai

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search AI Blocks in the shape ChatGPT deep research and company knowledge use: results with id, title and url. Read one with fetch. search_library does the same with filters and one-line summaries.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Read one item by the id from search (such as skill/ad-angle-planner): its full text (the SKILL.md, or the AI tool or mini tool record), url to cite and metadata. Text over 48,000 characters is cut; metadata.rest says how to read the rest.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: prepare_outcome_pattern, search_library, plan_workflow, get_resource, prepare_workflow, get_item, search, fetch · Private data: start_outcome, record_outcome_decision, record_outcome_experiment, prepare_outcome_pattern, find_specialist, prepare_specialist, plan_workflow, get_skill, get_resource, get_item, fetch · Public sink: record_outcome_experiment, prepare_outcome_pattern, plan_workflow, prepare_workflow · Destructive: start_outcome, advance_outcome, get_workflow, prepare_workflow.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: prepare_outcome_pattern, search_library, plan_workflow, get_resource, prepare_workflow, get_item, search, fetch · Private data: start_outcome, record_outcome_decision, record_outcome_experiment, prepare_outcome_pattern, find_specialist, prepare_specialist, plan_workflow, get_skill, get_resource, get_item, fetch · Public sink: record_outcome_experiment, prepare_outcome_pattern, plan_workflow, prepare_workflow · Destructive: start_outcome, advance_outcome, get_workflow, prepare_workflow

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
